title: MCP server (Python)
summary: A read-only MCP server on the official SDK (mcp 2.3): checked arguments, customer text marked untrusted, capped results, pinned tool descriptions, a chained audit file.
verified: RUN: the scaffold's 6 tests and its 8 contract cases ran here through a real MCP client in memory with mcp 2.3.0, including the argument checks, the untrusted envelope, the tool pins and the audit chain; the project audit reads READY. Not run against a live client session or over HTTP.
stack_line: A read-only MCP server in Python (mcp 2.3).
live: No model and no key: connect a client with claude mcp add orders -- uv run --project . -m server.app
